items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: The interviewee identifies Oil Humphrey as a trombone player in a band context but does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with him.

ctx.x: Not Poison. Oil Humphrey. Not Poison. The trombone player, Oil Humphrey. Yeah. Oil. Oil, that's right. Oil, yeah, trombone. He was playing trombone. He was playing trombone. And the bass player, I can't think of his name. He's dead. He's dead. I can't think of his name.
You from downtown here? You see, we stay uptown. Yeah, I mean, the bass player, where do you live?
